categories.main_business_segments: Yizumi Holdings Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the mold forming equipment industry, focusing on the design, R&D, production, sales, and service of injection molding machines, die casting machines, and rubber injection molding machines. The company serves multiple industries including automotive, 3C electronics, home appliances, packaging, medical, and light industry. It also engages in global operations with subsidiaries in regions such as North America, India, Thailand, Mexico, and Turkey.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced manufacturing technologies including Industrial 4.0 smart manufacturing, servo-driven hydraulic systems, intelligent control systems with remote monitoring and digital twin technology, and high-speed molding processes. Key products include the A6 high-end intelligent injection molding machine series, NEXT2 two-plate die casting machines, and LEAP series large die casting machines. Yizumi integrates mechanical, electrical, automation, energy-saving, new materials, and software development in its R&D efforts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yizumi serves major customers in the automotive, 3C electronics, home appliance, packaging, medical, and light industrial sectors. Its products are used globally, with significant market presence in China and overseas markets including North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, and India. The company collaborates with leading automotive parts manufacturers and other industrial clients worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with major production bases in Guangdong (Shunde High-tech Zone), Suzhou, and Zhejiang (planned East China base). Overseas operations include subsidiaries and production facilities in the United States (Ohio), India (Gujarat), Thailand, Mexico, and Turkey. Its sales and service network covers over 90 countries and regions globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yizumi operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of mold forming equipment such as injection molding machines, die casting machines, and rubber injection machines. It integrates upstream R&D and downstream sales and service, positioning itself as a comprehensive equipment solution provider in the polymer and metal forming industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous innovation with strategic priorities on digital intelligence, global operations, and green development. R&D efforts emphasize smart, precise, energy-efficient, and environmentally friendly equipment, including development of servo systems, intelligent control platforms, and high-speed molding technologies. Yizumi invests heavily in expanding its global innovation platform and enhancing product quality and customer value through a three-tier R&D system.
categories.revenue_model: Yizumi generates revenue primarily through the sale of injection molding machines, die casting machines, rubber injection machines, and related products. Sales are conducted via direct sales domestically and a combination of direct and distributor sales internationally. The company also earns income from after-sales services, financing leases, and government subsidies related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yizumi is one of the leading equipment manufacturers in China’s mold forming machinery industry, ranking second among Chinese plastic machinery manufacturers and injection molding machine producers. It competes with both domestic and international brands by focusing on high-end, intelligent, and green equipment. The company has established a strong brand reputation domestically and internationally, leveraging technological innovation and global market expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Yizumi achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.06 billion, a 23.61% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 607.9 million, up 27.42%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 7.11 billion, with net assets of RMB 2.96 billion. It maintains a strong growth trajectory supported by increased R&D investment, global expansion, and operational efficiency improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yizumi emphasizes differentiated product competitiveness through technological innovation, focusing on intelligent, precise, green, and efficient manufacturing solutions. Its products incorporate advanced servo and control technologies, digital twin capabilities, and high-speed molding processes to enhance production efficiency and quality. The company’s global innovation platform and comprehensive service network provide customers with tailored, high-value solutions, especially for emerging sectors like new energy vehicles and precision electronics.
